overview: The paper proposes Supervised Reinforcement Learning (SRL), a framework that reformulates reasoning as sequential decision-making to train LLMs on hard problems where SFT overfits and RLVR fails, utilizing step-wise expert action decomposition and a dense sequence similarity reward combined with dynamic sampling and subsequent RLVR refinement.

modules.name: Expert Trajectory Decomposition (Math)
modules.description: Parses structured reasoning traces from math datasets, identifying numbered step titles and corresponding content, and rewriting them into a standardized step-by-step format to serve as logical actions.

modules.name: Expert Trajectory Decomposition (SWE)
modules.description: Extracts executable environment commands (actions) from software engineering agent trajectories, separating them from the natural language reasoning and environment observations.

modules.name: Step-Wise Data Construction Engine
modules.description: Converts a single full expert trajectory into multiple partial trajectory training instances by slicing the solution at each intermediate step, creating contexts where the model must predict the subsequent step.

modules.name: SRL Prompt Templating
modules.description: Constructs the input prompt for the policy model, incorporating the partial solution context and instructions for the model to generate an inner monologue followed by the specific logical action.

modules.name: Sequence Similarity Reward Function
modules.description: Calculates the dense reward signal by comparing the model's predicted action sequence against the expert action sequence using a sequence matching algorithm, returning a similarity ratio or a negative penalty for format violations.

modules.name: Dynamic Variance-Based Sampling Filter
modules.description: Filters training samples by calculating the standard deviation of sequence similarity rewards across multiple rollouts, discarding samples with near-zero variance to ensure meaningful policy gradient updates.

modules.name: SRL Rollout & Reward Aggregation
modules.description: Manages the generation of multiple reasoning rollouts per prompt, separates the generated inner monologue from the logical action, computes the sequence similarity reward for the action, and aggregates results for the optimizer.

modules.name: GRPO Loss Calculation (SRL Adapted)
modules.description: Implements the Group Relative Policy Optimization objective function, replacing the outcome-based advantage with the normalized step-wise sequence similarity advantage while maintaining the clipping and KL penalty constraints.

modules.name: SRL Training Orchestration
modules.description: Manages the main training loop for the SRL phase, coordinating data loading, rollout generation, dynamic filtering, advantage normalization, and parameter updates using the SRL-adapted GRPO loss.

modules.name: RLVR Refinement Orchestration
modules.description: Manages the secondary training phase where the SRL-trained model is further optimized using standard Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards based on final answer correctness.

modules.name: Math Reasoning Evaluation Suite
modules.description: Evaluates model performance on competition-level math benchmarks using greedy decoding and temperature-based sampling to compute average accuracy metrics (Avg@k) and extract boxed final answers.

modules.name: Software Engineering Evaluation Suite
modules.description: Assesses the agentic reasoning capabilities by executing model-generated patches in a sandbox environment to calculate resolve rates for both oracle file editing and end-to-end scenarios.

modules.name: Experiment Pipeline Configuration
modules.description: Handles the distinct hyperparameter and configuration management required for the sequential SFT, SRL, and RLVR phases, ensuring consistent data flow and logging across the multi-stage training pipeline.
